description: Stamp a text watermark on every page of a PDF: your text, opacity, rotation, size and color — done in your browser with PDF-Lib.

faqs.a: The watermark is drawn into the page content itself, so it survives copying, printing and conversion.
Yes — rotate it anywhere from 0° to 90°, and the preview math places it centered on each page regardless of page size.
faqs.q: Can I use a diagonal watermark?

faqs.a: Everything runs locally in your browser with PDF-Lib. Files are never uploaded to any server.

howto: Type the watermark text (e.g. DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL).
Set opacity, rotation, size and color.
